definitions.explanation: Two months from the current month.

examples.japanese: {再来月|さらいげつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}します→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧。
examples.english: I'm moving the month after next.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{再来月|さらいげつ}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The wedding is the month after next.

examples.japanese: {再来月|さらいげつ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}める→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: I'll start a new job from the month after next.

examples.japanese: {再来月|さらいげつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦{休|やす}みたい→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: I have no plans the month after next, so I want to relax.

examples.japanese: {再来月|さらいげつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{両親|りょうしん}→両親：00806_ryoushin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{外国|がいこく}→外国：02868_gaikoku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めている→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: My parents are coming from abroad the month after next, so I've started preparing now.

notes:
{再来月|さらいげつ} refers to the month after next — two months from now. It is a standard time expression used in everyday conversation and planning.

FORMS:
{再|さ} (again/further) + {来|らい} (coming) + {月|げつ} (month). The {再|さ} prefix adds one more step beyond ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧.

MONTH SEQUENCE:
- ⟦{先々月|せんせんげつ}→先々月：21528_sensengetsu⟧: two months ago
- ⟦{先月|せんげつ}→先月：00751_sengetsu⟧: last month
- ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧: this month
- ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧: next month
- {再来月|さらいげつ}: month after next

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {再来月|さらいげつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{初|はじ}め→初め：02931_hajime⟧: early in the month after next
- {再来月|さらいげつ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from the month after next
- {再来月|さらいげつ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: by the month after next

RELATED WORDS:
The same {再来|さらい} prefix applies to other time words: ⟦{再来年|さらいねん}→再来年：01417_sarainen⟧ (year after next), ⟦{再来週|さらいしゅう}→再来週：01416_saraishuu⟧ (week after next).
